# Get to the Movie!

> A quiz that matches you to one of six Arnold Schwarzenegger personas and recommends his films that fit it.

Get to the Movie! is a free web quiz. You answer 7 questions and get matched to one of six Arnold personas: Terminator, Commando, Kindergarten Cop, Total Recall, True Lies or Mr. Freeze. The result shows your persona, the runner-up and why you matched, followed by up to three Arnold films for that persona, each with a line of Arnold-style commentary.

## How it works
1. Answer 7 questions about your mood, energy, brain capacity, era preference, decision style, workout vibe and catchphrase energy.
2. Each persona weights those answers differently, and the highest total wins.
3. Every persona has a short hand-picked list of Arnold films. The quiz fetches them from TMDB, puts the ones from your preferred era first, sorts by rating, and shows up to three.

## The personas
- Terminator Arnold (The Machine): the Terminator films
- Commando Arnold (Pure 80s Firepower): Commando, Predator, The Running Man and other 80s action
- Kindergarten Cop Arnold (Heart of Gold): Kindergarten Cop, Twins, Junior, Jingle All the Way
- Total Recall Arnold (The Paranoid Thinker): Total Recall, The 6th Day, End of Days
- True Lies Arnold (The Smooth Operator): True Lies, Last Action Hero, Collateral Damage
- Mr. Freeze Arnold (The Camp King): Batman & Robin, Hercules in New York

Each persona has a share page at https://gettothemovie.iamjarl.com/share/{persona}, for example /share/commando.

## Technical
- Built with Next.js 16 as a static site
- Movie data from the TMDB API
- Free, no account needed
